title: FlexLine Credit Limit Increase Terms by Tier
content:
The tier terms that apply to credit-limit increase requests on FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.

| Tier | Months open before an increase request | Consecutive on-time minimum payments | Largest increase per request (% of the current limit) | Increase requests accepted per rolling 6 months | Hard credit inquiry |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 9 | 6 | 25 | 1 | Yes |
| FlexLine Standard | 6 | 6 | 25 | 1 | Yes |
| FlexLine Plus | 6 | 6 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| FlexLine Preferred | 6 | 6 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| FlexLine Premier | 6 | 6 | 40 | 1 | Yes |
| FlexLine Elite | 6 | 6 | 50 | 1 | Yes |

Column definitions as carried for the product:

- Whole calendar months the line must have been open before a limit increase request.
- Consecutive most recent minimum payments made on time required for an increase (integer).
- Largest increase granted per request, percent of the current limit (and never above the tier maximum).
- Increase requests accepted per line in any rolling 6 months (integer).
- Whether a limit increase request uses a hard credit inquiry.

## Notes

FlexLine Starter is the only tier with a 9-month opening period; the other five tiers use 6 months. The largest increase rises with the tier, from 25% on FlexLine Starter and FlexLine Standard to 50% on FlexLine Elite. *Hypothetical illustration:* 30% of a 6000.00 USD limit is 1800.00 USD.
